value.title: Time limits and check-ins
value.summary: Roadmap 001 s12: a request can carry `--limit`; without one the role's default_limit applies (C5); when the limit passes with no output and no card update, pij sends the seat one check-in, and tells the PA (else the prime) if it goes unanswered, all inside the existing watchdog round.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Delivers req-22; builds c-limits. Depends on s05 (the request store holds the limit). Nothing is ever stopped. The opt-in quiet-seat watchdog is unchanged.

value.claim: Check-in. In the existing watchdog round, a request whose limit has passed with no output (s06) and no card update since the request (each card update restarts it) gets one check-in to its seat, delivered as to any busy seat: write what you have, update your card, say why it needs longer.
Escalate. If the check-in goes unanswered (no output or card update by the next limit window), pij tells the PA (else the prime) once.
Defaults. Without --limit, the role's default_limit (pij/role, C5) applies; with neither, no limit.

Cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property). No new timer or launch: the check runs inside the existing watchdog round and costs a store query per open request with a limit; check-ins and notices are one delivery each. State the round's added query cost.

Docs and states. In this PR: roadmap s12 goes to complete (plan cell docs/plans/205-time-limits); req-22 goes to shipped; c-limits goes to shipped. docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents new verbs and refusals; the skill's verb coverage tables carry them; `just ddocs-check` and `ddocs validate` on the project docs pass; the PR body has a `Delivers:` line.

value.risk: Two lanes edit the same CLI wiring or skill files.
value.mitigation: Rebase onto main before the PR; small diffs at the seam; pm-001 orders merges.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
